Treat that as manufacturer positioning, then make the practical choice from the rod, lure, cover and exact diameter. A full mono fill is a simpler starting point than a braid-style backing plan. Before using these historical inputs for a package in hand, check that its identity and labeling match the 2018 scope.

before.suitabilitySummary: The manufacturer's historical positioning is coastal and offshore mainline use. Choose the strength for the rod, drag, rig and contact hazards, then match its diameter to the reel. A large bulk package can supply several fills, but it does not make a small reel suitable for thick mono. The High Impact name is not a substitute for checking knots and damaged line after use.

after.suitabilitySummary: High Impact was positioned for coastal and offshore mono main-line fishing. Choose a strength that suits the rod, drag and rig, then check the diameter against the reel's capacity. The larger packages can provide multiple fills; keep enough working line for the intended deployment and runs, and replace damaged sections after use.

The verified 10 and 12 lb packages are .007 and .008 in, so backing can be important when a 150 yd package is shorter than a reel's calculated full-spool amount. These are label-based capacity estimates, not measured casting, sink-rate, or abrasion comparisons.

after.suitabilitySummary: Forward is Berkley's braid for finesse presentations, including forward-facing-sonar fishing. The verified 10 and 12 lb options are worth evaluating on appropriately matched light tackle, with a leader chosen for the rig. Plan a working section from the 150-yard package and use backing where needed, keeping reserve for fish runs and repeated retying.

after.suitabilitySummary: Super Knot is a monofilament main-line option for a straightforward, continuous connection to the lure. For a spool matching this historical range, choose a strength for the tackle and check the printed diameter before spooling. The 8 lb row is 0.012 inch, so compare its actual fill requirement with the 220-yard package rather than relying on pound test alone.

before.suitabilitySummary: Use this reference when your spool matches SCB30040-22, its test rating, color and printed diameter. A 300-yard package can supply a long working section or more than one shorter fill, depending on reel capacity and reserve. Choose the amount around casting distance and the room needed to fight a fish; the package length does not mean every reel holds all 300 yards.

after.suitabilitySummary: The 40 lb Sonic Braid package covered here is worth evaluating for a casting setup with a rod, lure and cover suited to that strength. Its 300-yard supply can provide one long working section or several shorter fills, depending on the reel. Leave enough braid above any backing for long casts, fish runs and trimming.

before.suitabilitySummary: P-Line positions CXX for demanding cover and shock loading. That is manufacturer positioning, not an independent performance test. The pictured 10 lb line is .014 inch and the 12 lb is .0148 inch, so plan the reel fill with the exact label rather than a generic 10 or 12 lb mono rating. Rod range, lure weight, cover, and drag still determine an appropriate strength.

after.suitabilitySummary: CXX is P-Line's copolymer main line for demanding cover and shock-loading applications. The 10 and 12 lb packages covered here have substantial diameters, so check handling and capacity before choosing them for a small spinning reel. Match the strength to the rod and lure, and keep spare working line for retying after contact with cover.

before.suitabilitySummary: FloroClear is an option when the intended main line is a coated copolymer rather than a full fluorocarbon or braid construction. P-Line identifies a silicone treatment; no independent handling advantage is claimed here. Check the exact filler or bonus package before planning capacity, because the inspected 12 lb packages do not print identical inch diameters.

after.suitabilitySummary: FloroClear is a coated-copolymer option when you want a continuous main line rather than a braid-and-leader setup. Choose a manageable diameter for the reel and plan a full fill or a fresh working section over backing. Check the exact filler or bonus package against the chart, because the reviewed 12 lb packages print different inch diameters.

before.suitabilitySummary: HALO belongs in a full-fluorocarbon mainline comparison, separately from CX Premium and FloroClear. The three verified US carton labels offer .008, .01, and .011 inch reference diameters. Choose strength for the rod, presentation, and cover before estimating the fill. P-Line's Co-Fluoride construction name is not evidence of a measured performance advantage over another fluorocarbon.

after.suitabilitySummary: HALO is a fluorocarbon main-line option to consider for a light or moderate working fill. The verified 6, 8 and 10 lb packages give you three diameters to compare with the reel's capacity. Choose strength for the lure and cover, then decide between a continuous full fill and a shorter fresh section over sound backing.

before.suitabilitySummary: P-Line describes eight-carrier EndurX as braid made from material colored before braiding. The retained labels support a .009-inch Electric Green 20 lb option and a .011-inch Midnight Black 30 lb option. They do not establish all EndurX colors at those strengths. Compare diameter for capacity while choosing strength, leader, and drag for the fishing; color-retention marketing is not a measured result here.

faqs.question: Is this the four-carrier EndurX?
faqs.answer: No. The accepted labels identify EndurX 8X, and P-Line's matching description specifies eight carriers. Four-carrier EndurX is outside this reference.

faqs.question: What is the verified 30 lb Midnight Black diameter?
faqs.answer: The actual PEBB-300-30 label prints .011 inch and .28 mm. Its 300-yard package is the only 30 lb package included here.

faqs.question: Can I choose Electric Green at 30 lb from this chart?
faqs.answer: Not from this evidence. The verified Electric Green package is 20 lb; the verified 30 lb label is Midnight Black. Other color-strength combinations need their own primary evidence.

faqs.question: Does Zero Fade mean this page guarantees color retention?
faqs.answer: No. That wording identifies the pictured manufacturer packaging. This reference neither independently tests the claim nor establishes warranty eligibility, production year, or present stock.

Use enough working braid for the fishing and future trimming, with backing below it when useful.

faqs.answer: Backing can provide a secure base on a smooth arbor and fill space below a chosen working braid section. Follow the reel maker's attachment instructions and keep enough braid above the connection for casts, runs and retying.
